description: This file defines a Flutter widget for an OTP validation and login screen, including social login buttons, phone number input, and navigation logic, primarily for user authentication.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents options for user login via phone number, Google, Facebook, or Apple, with supporting UI and navigation logic.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the Continue button, including triple-tap testing and proceeding with phone login.

methods.name: _bypassLoginForTesting
methods.description: Shortcut method for testing that sets login state and navigates directly to HomeActivity.

methods.name: _onContinueWithPhone
methods.description: Validates the entered phone number and navigates to OTPSecondScreen if valid.

methods.name: _onGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Mocks a Google Sign-In process, updates preferences, and navigates to HomeActivity.
